title: Billabong SMP
description: Billabong SMP is a vast modded multiplayer Minecraft experience.
body: Billabong SMP is a vast multiplayer modded Minecraft experience. Roam the Earth, explore ancient structures, invent contraptions, and build to your heart's desire, all with the company of your friends and other fellow Billabong SMP players. It is based on Minecraft 1.20.1 and uses the Forge mod loader. For more information, see https://mc.aezign.au/Billabong:About
